question: 按自然季度计算，2024 年第三季度（7–9 月）末 HP 的总资产是多少百万美元？

tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql": "SELECT f.value
FROM facts f
JOIN periods p ON f.company_id = p.company_id
 AND f.fiscal_year = p.fiscal_year
 AND f.fiscal_quarter = p.fiscal_quarter
WHERE f.company_id = 'HP'
  AND f.account_code = 'total_assets'
  AND f.version = 'original'
  AND p.calendar_quarter = '2024Q3'"}

tool_calls.name: final_answer
tool_calls.arguments: {"answer_md": "按自然季度 2024Q3（7–9 月）期末，HP 的总资产为 38,059 百万美元。", "claims": [{"text": "HP 2024Q3 期末总资产", "value": 38059, "unit": "usd_mn"}]}

answer_md: 按自然季度 2024Q3（7–9 月）期末，HP 的总资产为 38,059 百万美元。
